tools.name: axenomia_agent_passport
tools.description: Read the versioned AX-SCI-001 Agent Passport: scope, evidence rules, evaluation status, limitations and human-review requirements.

tools.name: axenomia_human_review_gate
tools.description: Return the mandatory human-review boundary for AX-SCI-001. This tool never approves patentability, novelty, publication or research-priority decisions.

tools.name: ax_sci_001_assess_evidence
tools.description: Research and synthesize traceable scientific evidence for a research question. Returns provisional evidence findings, verification depth, gaps and next evidence needs. Final novelty, patentability and publication judgments remain human-gated.

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "axenomia_human_review_gate" stacks urgency/override words (never, mandatory). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.
